content: आतिथ्य {%a.%} [अतिथेरिदं ष्यञ्] Hospitable, proper for a guest <ab>&c.</ab> (= आतिथेय); हविरातिथ्यम्, आतिथ्या इष्टिः <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-थ्यः@} A guest. .{@-थ्यम्@} or {@-थ्या@} .²1 Hospitable reception, hospitality; तमातिथ्यक्रियाशान्तरथक्षोभपरिश्रमम् <ls>R. 1. 58</ls>. .²2 a particular rite, the reception of Soma when it is brought to the sacrificial place (also called आतिथ्येष्टिः)
